agents.name: Spec Kit Driver
agents.description: Primary agent that orchestrates GitHub Spec Kit's SDD workflow with mandatory review gates, a pre-plan requirements-analysis pass, and dependency-ordered parallel wave execution.

agents.name: Roadmap Driver
agents.description: Primary agent that walks a roadmap document feature by feature on top of the Spec Kit inner loop, with per-feature checkpoints, git commits, journaling, and a headless loop runner.

subagents.name: FeatureRunner
subagents.description: Executes exactly one roadmap feature through the full Spec Kit inner loop (specify, analysis, plan, tasks, waves, converge) and returns COMPLETE or BLOCKED; never asks the owner and never edits the state file.

commands.name: SDD
commands.description: Entry command routing /sdd <request> to the spec-kit-driver agent.

commands.name: Roadmap
commands.description: Entry command routing /roadmap <request> to the roadmap-driver agent: init, next, status, approve, resume, milestone.

scripts.name: Roadmap Loop Runner
scripts.description: Headless roadmap runner: drives the roadmap-driver agent iteration by iteration with --feature, --approve, and --auto-checkpoint; exits 2 on a pending checkpoint and 3 on a blocker.

contexts.name: Spec Kit Driver Navigation
contexts.description: Map of the driver context files, when to load each, and where the runtime config and Spec Kit artifacts live.

contexts.name: Spec Kit Driver Workflow
contexts.description: Full command sequence, gate protocol, requirements-analysis pass, and bug-fix flow for the spec-kit-driver.

contexts.name: Spec Kit Artifacts
contexts.description: Spec Kit on-disk layout (.specify/, specs/<###-feature>/) and feature-directory resolution via .specify/feature.json and SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY.

contexts.name: Spec Kit Wave Execution
contexts.description: Task-parsing rules, DAG/wave computation, sidecar schema, dispatch thresholds, live ticking, validation, stop rules, and converge re-planning.

contexts.name: Spec Kit Evidence Protocol
contexts.description: Evidence rules: no completion claim without fresh command output, and the verdict format for bug-fix flows.

contexts.name: Roadmap Loop Protocol
contexts.description: Canonical roadmap outer-loop protocol: state schema, initialization, eligibility, checkpoints, report schema, journal/commits, headless behavior, and boundaries.

contexts.name: TypeScript Standards
contexts.description: TypeScript conventions for Node.js projects: strict compiler discipline, type modeling, ESM imports, async/error handling, naming, and testing expectations.

bug.name: bug
bug.description: Opt-in Spec Kit bug-fix extension: assess -> fix -> test flow with verified/partial/failed verdicts.
